summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction by PDMR Maya Martinez-Davis, President, US, who acquired notional ADS within her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account. No forced or abrupt departure or major management change is disclosed; the filing is a routine director/PDMR shareholding notification under UK rules, mapped to a US Form 4 equivalent. Terms: 9.455 ADS at $50.50 each. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural deal mechanics. This is not a special situation; the "Management Changes" category is used only because the filing refers to a PDMR transaction, but the event is routine and not an actual management change.
